Chapter 5961: Resting Bull Scripture

Chapter 5961: Resting Bull Scripture

Elucidation True Emperor obtained an egg from Beastcoin City. This egg turned out to be a Bi’an later, serving as the divine guardian of Resting Bull.

“Young Noble, are you suggesting that the divine beast is still here… it’s right beneath us?” Edge Mountain Crone couldn’t believe it.

They had not seen this divine beast for eras now. It was rumored to be dead or had abandoned them. How could they not know if it was still around?

“Not only your divine guardian but the emperor also left the scripture behind.” Li Qiye smiled while staring at the statue.

“Impossible!” She blurted. For generations, the descendants have searched every inch of the mountain to no avail.

Li Qiye smiled and picked up a blade of grass. With his dao infusion, it became resplendent and moist with dew, turning into a delicacy.

He placed it in the ox statue’s mouth and it emitted a grass fragrance. The statue somehow returned to life and ate the grass.

“Moo!” It stood up and came closer to Li Qiye, leaving the daoist and the old demon slack-jawed.

A living bull with flesh and powerful muscles stood before them. Li Qiye smiled and rubbed the ox’s head. The ox seemed to enjoy his touch.

The old demon thought of how countless disciples had played around the statue. How did they not notice anything?

“Moo…” It returned to its original position and lay down.

“Rumble!” It dispersed into dao light and laws, culminating in a magnificent river above the sect.

Her eyes pierced through the radiance and she saw a pulsing scripture.

“Resting Bull Scripture!” She shouted.

The others noticed the phenomenon and gazed at the boundless radiance.

She lunged into the air, wanting to seize the scripture. The moment her hand touched the light, an unknown force sent her flying while vomiting blood.

“You can’t get through Elucidation True Emperor’s technique.” Li Qiye shook his head.

He took one step forward and tried as well. The boundless dao power couldn’t stop his advance.

“Rumble!” The entire mountain shook violently to the members’ dismay.

The earth fissured by the base of the mountain. It widened repeatedly after loud explosions until the mountain was cleaved in two.

“Boom!” A bestial aura erupted and suppressed everyone including the strongest cultivator - Edge Mountain Crone.

When they looked down at the chasm, they saw a gigantic beast the size of an earth vein. It resembled a tiger or a dog. Its bright fur cascaded like waterfalls made of gold.

“The divine guardian, Bi’an!” She recognized the creature.

“Rumble!” The beast awakened and raised its head, displaying its full majestic appearance. It had a pair of horns with a chilling glint. They branched outward at the top like a series of blades.

“Our divine beast!” Members of the sect couldn’t contain their emotions since the divine beast hadn’t abandoned them. Their missing divine beast finally appeared again.

“Pop.” When it opened its eyes, the pressure intensified and stopped everyone from moving. Alas, the light in its eyes only lasted for a second.

Edge Mountain Crone noticed this and understood why it hadn’t been protecting them actively.

“Even divine beasts grow old.” Li Qiye smiled, confirming her suspicion. It seemed their divine beast didn’t have much longer to live.

“Boom!” Li Qiye grabbed the pulsing scripture.

“Rumble!” Dao runes and laws gushed outward, twisting together to form characters.
